ResourceAccessTokenId.description: Unique identifier of the resource access token to update.

ValidityStartUtc.title: String update value
ValidityStartUtc.description: Marks the start of interval in which the resource access token can be used (or null if not being updated).

ValidityEndUtc.title: String update value
ValidityEndUtc.description: Marks the end of interval in which the resource access token can be used (or null if not being updated).

Value.title: String update value
Value.description: Value of the resource access token (or null if not being updated).

Permissions.title: Resource access token permission parameter
Permissions.description: Specify permissions of the resource access token (or null if not being updated).
